The Future of Payments is More Than Just the Next 'Shiny New Toy'
summary: At Payments Unleashed in London, Tom Warsop, CEO, ACI Worldwide joined FinextraTV to share his insights into where payments are heading and what the future will look like. Warsop describes the benefits of a forum to focus on how to progress payments towards a new future. He explained how the industry has a tendency to focus on the 'shiny new toy' and how payments are not forgiving, so execution has to be watertight. He describes the unfortunate reality of how conceptualisation is a lot easier than reality, and payments often runs into the struggles of this realisation - the hard work begins when the conceptual part is down and it's turned into a reality.
content: At the Payments Unleashed event in London, industry leaders discussed the future of the payments sector. Discussions emphasized that while conceptualizing new financial technology is easy, executing it successfully requires rigorous hard work. Experts warned against constantly chasing 'shiny new toys,' stressing that flawless execution is critical because the payments industry is deeply unforgiving of operational mistakes.
